The '''Felucia medical station''' was a [[Haven-class medical station/Legends|''Haven''-class medical station]] used for treating injured [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and other [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] military personnel during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was [[Destruction of the Felucia medical station/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="SW Annual 2011" />
